Performing Gene Ontology (GO) Enrichment Analyses

GCP_GO.Rd

It performs multiple Gene Ontology (GO) Enrichment Analyses for each pairwise comparison using the function enrichGO() from the clusterProfiler package. The genes used are the ones retrieved from the 'Gene names' column of proteinINFO.

Usage

GCP_GO(
  GCPlist,
  name_column_groups = getOption("GetCoolProteopipe.name_column_groups"),
  use_FDRPvalue = TRUE,
  Pvalue_column = NULL,
  Pvalue_cutoff = 0.05,
  differential_analysis = TRUE,
  use_logFC = TRUE,
  FC_column = NULL,
  FC_cutoff = 0,
  background_from_data = TRUE,
  OrgDb = "human",
  keyType = "SYMBOL",
  ont = c("ALL", "BP", "MF", "CC"),
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  pAdjustMethod = "none",
  qvalueCutoff = 0.2,
  ...
)

Arguments

GCPlist

a list created with the ImportOutputMaxQuant function.

name_column_groups

NULL or character of length 1. The name of the column of the sampleINFO table containing the sample groups. If NULL, you will need to specify Pvalue_column and, possibly, FC_column, see below.

use_FDRPvalue

logical. If name_column_groups is specified and if this is TRUE, this function will consider columns with FDR p-values in proteinINFO; otherwise, it will consider columns with the p-values in proteinINFO.

Pvalue_column

NULL or character. If name_column_groups was not specified, you can directly pass here the column names of proteinINFO you want to consider as p-values.

Pvalue_cutoff

numeric. P-values below this numner will be consider as statistically significant and relative gene names will be considered.

differential_analysis

logical. If TRUE, it will perform two separate analyses for each pairwise condition considering the Fold Changes, see below;if FALSE; it will only perform an analyses for each pairwise condition.

use_logFC

logical. If name_column_groups is specified and if this is TRUE, this function will consider columns with log FC in proteinINFO; otherwise, it will consider columns with FC in proteinINFO.

FC_cutoff

numeric. significant FC higher than this value will be considered for the differential 'up' analysis, and significant FC lower than this value will be considered for the differential 'down' analysis.

background_from_data

logical. If TRUE; the "universe" passed to enrichGO will be valid unique gene names from all the not-NA protein groups; if FALSE, all genes listed in the database will be used as background.

OrgDb

One of "human", "mouse", or "rat"; or an OrgDb object to pass to clusterProfiler::enrichGO. If "human", the OrgDb "org.Hs.eg.db" will be used; if "mouse", "org.Mm.eg.db"; if "rat", "org.Rn.eg.db". In any case, you need to have that package installed; if you don't, please follow the instruction explained in the error message to do so.

keyType

character of length 1. The keyType to pass to clusterProfiler::enrichGO. Considering that the values are taken from the 'Gene names' of proteinINFO, this should be "SYMBOL" as the defalut.

ont

One of "ALL", "BP", "MF", or "CC". ont to pass to clusterProfiler::enrichGO.

pvalueCutoff

numeric. pvalueCutoff to pass to clusterProfiler::enrichGO.

pAdjustMethod

one of "none", "holm", "hochberg", "hommel", "bonferroni", "BH", "BY", "fdr". pAdjustMethod to pass to clusterProfiler::enrichGO.

qvalueCutoff

numeric. qvalueCutoff to pass to clusterProfiler::enrichGO.

...

Further argument to pass to clusterProfiler::enrichGO.

Value

a list with three elements:

  • considered_gene_names: a list with all the gene names considered.

  • SUMMARY_gene_names: a tibble which is a summary of the numbers of gene names considered.

  • GO_results: A list with dataframes, each containing the results of the GO.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{



# specifying a name_column_groups:

the_list_of_GO_results <- GCP_GO(GCPlist = GCPlist12,
                                 name_column_groups = "Condition",
                                 use_FDRPvalue = TRUE,
                                 Pvalue_cutoff = 0.05,
                                 differential_analysis = TRUE,
                                 use_logFC = TRUE,
                                 FC_cutoff = 0,
                                 background_from_data = TRUE,
                                 OrgDb = "mouse")

# not specifying a name_column_groups:

the_list_of_GO_results <- GCP_GO(GCPlist = GCPlist12,
                                 name_column_groups = NULL,
                                 Pvalue_column = c("ttest_V_vs_S_PvaluesFDR"),
                                 Pvalue_cutoff = 0.05,
                                 differential_analysis = TRUE,
                                 FC_column = c("V_vs_S_logFC"),
                                 FC_cutoff = 0,
                                 background_from_data = TRUE,
                                 OrgDb = "mouse")


} # }
